text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara loses in an exhibition race for an event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On her way back home, she runs into some spectators saying mean things about her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, simply happy to overhear people discussing her at all, she approaches the two and asks them to cheer her on in the next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spectators, seeing her full of spirit, end up becoming her fans.
